analyst_view.overall: Slovan Bratislava are bottom of the league phase with no points, one goal scored and 17 conceded, having lost every game by at least three goals, though they beat Ruzomberok 1-0 at the weekend. Cerepkai is out, Camara and Gajdos are doubts and Kuchariev is back after a long thigh injury. Betis are 11th on 9 points and drew 1-1 in the Seville derby; Pellegrini has taken a near-unchanged 24-man squad with Antony over his hip knock and Cucho Hernandez back, while Ceballos and Morante are out (already counted) and Losada was left out. French referee Jerome Brisard has been appointed. News on Slovan was thinner than on Betis.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, including about 1.0 for Slovan, who have scored once in four Champions League games; their ratings lean on domestic results that flatter them at this level. Betis look close to full strength with Antony fit and Cucho back, so their side of the count holds up and I only trim a little: 3.2 x 0.96, about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, with Betis around 6.1 and their busy recent corner counts already in (+3%). Betis should dominate the ball through Isco and Fornals while Slovan defend deep, which is already in both records. I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, reflecting Slovan's usual card rate when under pressure, and they had no referee on file. Jerome Brisard, now appointed, averages around four yellows a game in Ligue 1 with a fair number of reds, close to what the numbers expect, and nothing points to a more heated game than usual. I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.8 shots and add about 10% to Betis for how much Slovan concede. Slovan's own shooting at this level has been thin, and with Camara and Gajdos doubtful their attack is weaker still, while a full-strength Betis keeps its side up. A slight trim: 31.8 x 0.98, about 31.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, including a 6% boost for Betis. Slovan rarely test goalkeepers in this competition (one goal in four games), which their domestic-based ratings overstate, so I go to about 10.2.
